items.text: Welcome Bounty Hunters,

First of all, we want to say huge thanks to all of you who have taken the time to report to us all the bugs, issues, and problems that you encountered. All of your feedback was the foundation of the update that’s now in your download queue.

This new update is all about making Killsquad a much better experience. As we’re gearing up for the PS4 release of Killsquad (cross-play incoming!) we’ve made changes in the game’s core engine code and we gave Killsquad a performance upgrade too. We also added a new online system based on *EOS* so that we can improve online service and make the game well-prepared to crossplay with the incoming PS4 version.

To make your whole experience with Killsquad better, we’ve changed a lot of the game’s code. We had to make sure that this version is stable and it’s compatible with the PS4 device. To achieve that we had to re-work the particle/VFX system in CPU costs, tweak the animation system, the simulation of movement, and also the network processing. During all these changes a lot of bugs and problems occurred which we had to fix too. So this whole process took us quite a bit of time. But all of that work was definitely worth it, because as a result, we now have a much more optimized game!
Also, we’ve fixed the occasional crashes that some of you reported to us. Thanks to your help,Killsquad is more steady than ever.
Fixed a crash that occur opening reward chests
Fixed a crash that was provoked by Cass’ shuriken skill.
Fixed random crashes during contracts.
Fixed a crash that occurs during the Splash Screen
And finally, we have made fixes of other minor bugs (not crashing issues) that the Community have reported and many more that came up during the development of new systems and improvements.
Various localization bugs fixed on several items/cosmetics
Fixed performance issues with Meteors that spawn on some contracts
Fixed some rendering bugs related to the UI, lighting and also some contracts, that sometimes were shown too lighted
Fixed a bug where 2 assets of lamps were blocking the view of the game camera in some situations in the M.A.G.N.U.S battle.
Fixed a bug where sometimes the healing done in a contract was negative.
Fixed a bug where sometimes Gadgets were not shown on the UI playing a contract as a client
Fixed a bug where the traps located at “Trouble in paradise” contract, were not working properly playing as a client.
Fixed a bug where Numpad keys were not bindable in the game inputs.
Fixed a bug where some mobs spawned by Queen Mogoth got stuck under the ground.

Fixed a bug where the traps of Hunted Hunter contract were working incorrectly.

Fixed a minor bug where faction emote visuals were incorrectly distorted in the 3D preview
Fixed a minor bug where a light flash would appear on the screen every time you click on a gadget in the menus.
Fixed a bug where the tail of Queen Moggoth had physics and movement after it was cut.

items.text: Hello Bounty Hunters,

It’s been a while, hasn’t it!? Although we haven't spoken much recently, it doesn't mean that work on the game has stopped. Back in our studio, behind closed doors, we’ve been working on making Killsquad even better for you, our players. In this update you will find some new additions to the game that we hope will hit that Killsquad crave spot. So, here we go!

First up, Killsquad is getting 10 never-seen-before skill upgrades! From now on, each Hero will have 2 upgrades available. One of them with a cost of 1 TEC and the second with 2 TECs. Don’t have enough TECs? Not to worry! Go and play the Spec. Ops contracts and start collecting those sweet TECs right now!

If you are a fan of the Infinite or Elemental Colosseums, we have something just for you. With this update, you will get 4 new gear perks waiting for your disposal. Heal Up The Sleeve, Resting Stash, Prototype G, and Remedial Recovery can be added to your arsenal today and tip the balance of victory in your favour. Here’s a little brief intro on them:
Heal Up The Sleeve (exclusive for Troy): pick up a Card, and heal yourself by 1500 hp.
Resting Stash (all characters, exclusive legendary): reach a Resting Round in a Colosseum and gain 2 of each equipped Gadget (Gadget amount cannot exceed the max, total).
Prototype G (All characters, exclusive legendary): use a Gadget drone that follows you around. The drone will activate a random gadget effect every 5 seconds.
Remedial Recovery (All characters): boost your Basic Attacks with 50% lifesteal for 7 seconds. You can use this perk after successfully performing a Recovery.
But this is not all. The Invulnerable Dodge gear perk that was exclusive to Troy is now available to all Killsquad characters! Now the whole squad can use Invulnerable Dodge without any restrictions.

From now on while fighting in Elemental Colosseums you can unlock 12 new cosmetics for your heroes! In addition to getting that almighty feeling of victory, you can now also enjoy a visual upgrade in the appearance of your hero too.
Aerodynamic Boots (Legs)
Ronin Dō (Body)
Corrupted Flux Mask (Head)
Recycled Plate Armor (Body)
The Queen's Membrane (Body)
The Doorstopper (Body)
Customized Knight Gauntlets (Arms)
Shin Pads (Legs)
Champion Belt (Body)
Cobra-style Bamboo Hat (Head)
Copperplate Droid Arms (Arms)
Mutation Remnants (Legs)

And last but not least. We made some changes to the radar in the game. The Radar now shows the position of your enemies. Nearby enemies will appear as red circles on the radar, while those distant once will be shown as a red glow.

Those are just the main changes that we’ve implemented. We’ve also did a lot of smaller quality of life improvements too. If you want to know more details about all of the changes, check out our changelog below.
Hope you will all enjoy Killsquad’s new additions and have an even better time with our game. And as always if you have any questions, thoughts, leave them in the comment section down below.
May the universe be freed from alien scum.
You can see more detail on full patch notes down below,
Good luck Bounty Hunters,
Your Novarama Team.
A new Killsquad Update is here! And it comes with many and varied novelties! Let's start with a short summary of the highlights of the new content:

NEW HEROES SKILL UPGRADES

10 Brand new skill upgrades are coming for our heroes. Each Hero will have 2 upgrades with a cost of 1 and 2 TECs. You can now play the Spec.Ops contracts to get the extra TECs needed to get these upgrades!

• Tactical Repositioning (2 TEC cost): Whenever Troy dodges, he drops 3 land mines on the ground. When an enemy steps on them, they explode, dealing area damage to nearby enemies.

items.text: Hello Bounty Hunters,

Ho, ho, ho…ld onto your weapons! A brand new Killsquad’s Update that’s packed with new content is ready for you to enjoy. And this is a big one. It’s the endgame content that we promised you a few months ago. And to top it off, we’ve also added an extra bonus for you. A little something to bring the Xmas spirit to your screens. That’s right - the Killsquad Xmas event is making a comeback and is bringing some special gifts to bring you that Holiday cheer.

Welcome to the new Inferno Mode in which we have new Colosseums waiting. First up, we have three new Elemental Colosseums for you to try and test your luck with. It’s the ultimate test of strength and guile in which you face hordes of alien meat. And depending on the Colosseum you choose, you will face different foes. Although they might be different, the one thing that they do have in common is that they all have a weak spot. They are weak to the two elements of each colosseum BUT they are resistant to every other element that you will hit them with. So take advantage of their elemental weakness and reap some sweet rewards! And by sweet, we mean the all new Legendary Equipment! There is a Legendary Weapon, a Legendary Gear, and a Legendary Prototype waiting for a Bounty Hunter just like you. You can find the new Legendary Weapons, and Legendary Support/Prototype Gears by completing the Elemental Colosseums. You can also find Perks for the New Customization System that the Legendary Equipment have, letting you choose what upgrades they can carry to better fit your builds and playstyles.

We are also bringing you the Infinite Colosseum - a place with no round limit, but with each new wave, it gets harder and harder, until it may be impossible to continue. How long will you survive? You can play the Colosseum like you normally would. Or you can try out the new Competitive Mode with a New Ranking system. And if you do take on the challenge and go far enough, you’ll be able to mark your name in the New Ranking system. Make yourself a part of Killsquad’s history and be known as one of the best Bounty Hunters in the universe. Depending on your ranking, you will earn a shiny new badge. The higher the ranking, the higher the tier of the badge you get. You will also gain rewards for participating. These rewards aren't subject to your position in the ranking, but more about your individual skill. These rewards will rotate on a regular basis, so if you missed out on them the first time around, you will be able to unlock them later.

We’ve upped the Core limit of your Skills and Upgrades from 10 to 12, meaning that you now can get two new additional Cores! You can get those additional slots by unlocking the Veteran Contracts and the Spec. Ops. Contracts. So veterans, don’t freak out if you see two new Cores available. Since you’ve already played through those contracts, they’re there, waiting for you to make use of them. We’ve also added new tiers to all the badges in the game. Now each of them will have the "Jade" and "Antimatter" tier, with new milestones for you to reach.

And finally, for all of you alien killers out there that also love to spread Xmas joy, we have just the thing for you! Get those bells jingling as Killsquad’s 2021 Christmas Event has now officially started! And with it, we have all new Xmas goodies for you to unlock. We don’t want to spoil the whole fun, so we’ll leave the “discover what you can get” part all to you. But if you can, throw a snowball at one of your fellow squad members. It’ll be fun - trust us. Also, all of the previous Christmas event quests, portraits, and cosmetics are available as well. If you previously haven't had a chance to get them, well now is your chance to get them.
For more details on what’s in the update, see our changelog below.

And finally, we want to wish you a Happy Holiday and a fantastic New Year! May this time be full of joy, peace, and happiness. We also want to thank you for making 2021 a year that we will never forget. Thank you for being part of our game and in creating a community that we are forever grateful for.

We’ve heard your feedback from the last Steam News post so please take a look at the update, see what you think of the new content, and leave your thoughts below. And as always, we’re here to listen, so if something is on your mind, let us know.
Have a great break, all the best, and speak to you soon,
Your Novarama Team
The Inferno Mode Update is here! And with it comes the Endgame content! Here are some of the new features:

A new game mode: Inferno! Containing 3 new Elemental Colosseums, each one based on a different combination of the elements, they will offer you new challenges and where you'll be able to find upgrades for the...

New Legendary Equipment which you can customize with perks and level up to Vector 150. Find perks in the new Elemental Colosseums, and level legendary equipment by consuming other pieces of equipment. THEY HUNGER FOR POWER!

items.text: Hello Bounty Hunters,

The latest update is all about the Colosseum’s core system rework. We are bringing two reworked Colosseum modes to the game to give you more variety and more gameplay. Let us tell you about today’s changes in a bit more detail.

Recruit Colosseum is for those who do not fear the unknown. If you dare to enter this colosseum, you will stand against hordes of randomly spawning aliens. No Bounty Hunter knows what kind of enemy they will face here. Will it be a swarm of easy-to-kill aliens, or a pack of killers led by an even bigger killer! Nothing is certain in the Recruit Colosseum except that with each wave you manage to survive, the next will be harder to beat as enemies will have higher vector and enhancements.

The Veteran Colosseum is made for those Bounty Hunters who are on the cusp of greatest - or insanity. In this colosseum you will have to use both your brains and brawn. We took the Recruit Colosseum, but we added a bit more spice to it. It’s all about enemy versatility here. You will not only come across waves of aliens, but they also have various random enhancements too! This is the place where you need to engage both sides of your brain, and not just your thumbs. Non-standard solutions are highly encouraged.

Let us know in the comment section below what you think of these changes. We will be using this system as a basis for our endgame update too, so all your feedback, all your thoughts are most welcome. Which colosseum is your favourite, are you having fun with them, and what else comes to your mind when you play? Curious to hear your thoughts.
Good luck with the waves of aliens out there Bounty Hunter! And as always, read our changelog below for all the details.
Novarama Team

The Colosseum system rework is here! In this patch we've focused on reworking how the Colosseums work in order to make them more replayable. This new system allows us to randomize and enhance the flavor and variety of enemies depending on waves, vector and more to give you a new challenge every time you enter a Colosseum! With this update, we've made these changes available in the Recruit and Veteran Colosseums, and we will use it to its best potential in the Endgame update.
RECRUIT COLOSSEUM REWORK

The Recruit Colosseum has a focus on freshnes. Each time you enter the colosseum you will not know which enemies you will encounter. Maybe a wave of basic enemies trying to swarm you, or a swarm of enemies led by an elite one! In any case, the recruit Colosseum now contains all enemies you've seen on the Recruit Contracts!

We want you to feel the Colosseum different in many ways, so in addition to the recruit changes the system also allows a variety of enhancements to enemies that the player might need to find different ways of dealing with them. Imagine how different it is to fight against a rinosnail if it has an anti range barrier or a dolem if it has a full shield instead of HP... items.text: "Recovery" has been added to the game by popular demand, "Recovery" is a new mechanic where after being knocked back you can get up back into the fight faster, so you can avoid those nasty moments of knockback after knockback. This short opportunity to get back up by reacting at the right moment will help you keep the frenzy of the battle!

The economy of the game has been tweaked as well, balancing a bit the importance of the shop, leaning more towards contract rewards with the new "ambush chest". Inside of them you can find and earn that sweet rare loot. We also balanced the rewards for some contracts to smooth the progression throughout all the difficulties!

Single-player balance! All contracts from Recruit, Veteran and Plague contracts received a balance on time and difficulties. Now the progression curve should be a lot smoother. But don't worry, there are still some more harsh contracts for those seeking greater challenges!
WASTELAND 7A received its last flavour asset pack, with the laboratory theme now added to the map, giving it a unique identity to the world as a post-nuclear planet!
Also, there’s a lot more in there, such as polishing, more balance and bug fixing, a lot of bug fixing, and more bug fixing!
The update is now ready for you to download & enjoy. Please let us know your thoughts below. Finally, two last-minute requests:

If you have friends who would like to try Killsquad, tell them to get it now. We will be rising prices soon for the public release, and we want you guys & your friends to enjoy it at the best possible price.

If you haven’t done so already, and think we’re doing a good job, please consider leaving a review! We’re at a 69.50 review score now, we’d love to hit 70 before release, as that means the game moves to “Mostly Positive” reviews from “Mixed”. Every review counts, so if you have a spare minute or two, please leave one. You have no idea how much that will help us on release day.
Until next time, Bounty Hunters!
Your Novarama Team

While the death ray is active, Ekaar cannot use his other Skills. This Skill can be ended prematurely by reactivating it or when the Photonic bar reaches 0.

The Core 2 Update is here! This update comes with major changes. The skill and upgrade system has been reworked. Now, you can preview, buy, and equip from the skills menu to combine them in new and exciting ways. You will be able to explore these new features with the revamped UI, new interface, interactions and new functionalities such as shop rerolls or ways to save your preferred skill arrangements.
It's been a long journey, here you can see a list of all our game updates, and the roadmap of the upcoming ones:

PSA: Some of you might notice at the killsquad STEAM page some hidden Achievements. We are currently working on implementing them for the next summer update, so they are not achievable right now even if they show up.
PROGRESSION

In this update we have focused in reworking the core system of the character skills allowing full customization of your build using the new skill tree. Also, and maybe the more important change, your abilities are automatically upgraded inside a contract using the upgrades and skills you preselected at the skill tree.
TECS

A new unique currency is added to the game: TECS. They can be earned and found in contracts. Use these TECS to unlock Skills and Upgrades for a specific character in the Skill Tree. Look for them carefully as they exist in a specific amount for each character.
SAVE CONVERSION

With the new Skill and upgrade system we have a new currency, the TECs, if you have played a RECRUIT contract with a character before the update, you will receive the reward TEC for this character and contract the first time you open the game after the update. Apart from that you will be able to find more hidden TECs inside the RECRUIT and VETERAN contracts.
Skills tree

Added a skill tree to each character, use TECS to unlock Skills and upgrades. Equip them and combine them in new and exciting ways to achieve the play style you like. You will need to buy at least one upgrade from one level to unlock the purchase of the next level, after that you can equip whatever you want even if they are all level ten upgrades. Fully customize your build!
Builds and presets

Heroes have 10 cores that allows to assign skills and upgrades to their build. Each of them will have a cost, higher tiers will cost more than low tiered upgrades. Combine them in different ways to create the playstyle of your choice! Save the arrangements in one of the five available preset slots to switch between your skills and upgrades!
SKILLS AND UPGRADES

With the new system we have taken the opportunity of balancing existing upgrades, adding new ones, VFX & SFX. Also, all descriptions have been overhauled to improve readability and give more information to the player. It's well over 70 skill changes, so the list is too long to paste here. TUTORIALS

New Tutorials for all the new features. When you reach a new system or a new goal in the new progression system, a pop-up will show you how it works. You will be able to reopen this tutorial whenever you want, looking for the interrogation icon in the bottom right corner of the specific screen. We would like to thank you all for the feedback. Killsquad is an action-packed 4 player action RPG where sci-fi mercenaries raid planets seeking fame and glory. With four planets to explore, over thirty unique contracts to master, more than 100 weapons and 30 unique enemies, Killsquad offers an adrenaline-pumping journey into a dystopian future full of blood and black humour. Killsquad is now on Steam Early Access, with an approximate launch date of Summer 2021.

Killsquad is developed by Novarama, a Barcelona-based independent games developer with +18 years of experience, 11 of them as a Sony exclusive studio. With a team of +40 people, Novarama's mission statement is to building innovative games for mass audiences. Killsquad is our first fully self-published game. Visit Novarama's website at www.novarama.com
We are happy to announce the release our our newest update: Skua, available now!

With Skua, we deliver our fifth game world to the Killsquad universe. After visiting Wasteland07, Kemmekh, the Palace of Pain and the Colosseum of the Unseen, you're going in against your toughest challenge yet: Skua, the orbital space station of the Federation. Their training ground for new weapons and battle tactics.

Skua brings a full new storyline to Killsquad: expect new locations, all-new enemies and bosses, and new contracts for you to take. And yes, there's also new quests, cosmetics for you to show off your skill, new victory animations... well, you get the idea. Go Play!

The Skua update also brings our biggest-ever quality of life boost: we have been hard at work to raise performance across all hardware configurations, so you can expect higher frame rates, more fluid gameplay, and an overall smoother experience. We have also been stamping out bugs like there's no tomorrow. As we advance in our Early Access, we want to give you guys the best experience, and we feel Skua is a huge leap forward.
So, whether it's for the all-new adventures, or to rediscover the game with the new performance boost, jump in! There's a universe waiting for you.
Follow this link to read our full patch notes for the Skua update.
SKUA is available in English, Spanish, Italian, French, German, Russian, Simplified Chinese, Korean & Japanese.

Hello guys! What a recent two weeks we have had! Reviews are rising, sales are rising, we couldn’t be happier. So, first of all, THANK YOU guys for appreciating the effort we put in CORE. Being an Early Access means you guys get an open window into our development process, so expect a design-heavy Dev Diary today. So, come on, grab your thinking hats! Here we go!

We have realized we have two communities in the game. Some of you want to meet new people to play with. Others prefer Solo/Private play. So, sometimes the game is actually very active, but there seems to be no-one to play with, as everyone is doing Private contracts. Both sides are right, and we’re trying to please both with a game that caters to both audiences. To better understand the issue, we put all contracts Public for a few days to understand what is going on under the hood.

As a result of our analysis, we are beginning to take action. First, we are working on a fix that will lower the overall lag in the game. It will also tell you from the contract map what the ping time will be on each contract, to ensure the best online experience. Giving you guys a good online experience is key to us, so we expect us to roll this out soon. But rest assured: private contracts will return. We appreciate your patience while we fix this.
One question we are asked a lot is: how will the new Talisman system work? What are passives gonna be like? Ok, here’s a deep-dive, thanks to Miki, the game’s Lead Designer:
We want to give you better control on your hero’s build
So, we want to give you items you can equip, that create passive mods that boost your hero in some way. Some may be stat boosts, some may be more creative stuff you will need to discover.
These are the Talismans
Talismans are ancient artifacts of power, owned by The Unseen.
These Talismans have been shattered, and are now broken in pieces
Talisman pieces can be found in some contracts, and also as a reward for beating the Colosseum: some Talismans on the recruit Colosseum, some on the Veteran
So, to activate a Talisman, first you need to assemble it from its pieces

Once the Talisman is assembled, you unlock its passive ability. This is vector-less, so Talismans don’t become old as you Vector up. So for example a Talisman can give you increased Dodge regen time regardless of what your Vector is
On top of that, Talismans become better with use: the more you use them, the stronger they become, up to a cap in their power
And you can equip two of them any given time, so better choose well which are your weaknesses to assess what do you need to boost.

As you can see, Talismans are a veteran / end game feature. They will begin appearing in late recruit, but we feel these are for pro players who really want to max out their heroes. Here's a first look at the Talisman UI:

Part of that is cosmetics, which we had way too little of: we had some skins, and that was about it. On the next update, this is going to change. You are going to get funky hats. Boots. releases.displayName: Killsquad’s new major update, CORE, launches today

items.text: After 7 months of hard work & feedback from the community, we are pleased to release CORE today, Killsquad's newest update. CORE brings deep changes to all internal game systems & redefines the Killsquad experience. Every piece of feedback we got, we took it on board. And vowed to fix all of them in a single, mega-update. CORE has been on Beta testing now for a few weeks, during which the recent review score of Killsquad on Steam has risen from 64 to well over 85. So, the wait is over. Welcome to CORE, we hope you like it.

Before CORE, enemies levelled up: you levelled up, so did they. Bad idea: why keep playing, if enemies level up with you and the ratio stays the same? The full system is gone. Now, enemies have a static level. You don’t. So, level up to crush them mercilessly. And feel pleasure in doing so.

If you out-level enemies, we need more of them. CORE brings many new enemies across all sections of the game. Plus, it brings Enemy Generations: we have created +30 new enemy variations: new behaviours, new color schemes, new attack patterns… so there’s much more to hunt and destroy.

Enemies, attacks and weapons now have elemental resistance. So you’ll need the right tool for the right monster. Don’t use a freeze gun on an ice monster, you fool! You can also equip gear that builds up resistance against certain types of damage. So if Helldörren is frying you, gear up to counter that.

With elemental resistance, picking the right weapon is more important than ever. That’s why we give you dual weapons slots, with different damage profiles. Let’s call these the mob clearing and the boss buster weapon. Choose them wisely: both influence your level and your chances of survival.

In Killsquad, your character build comes from your gear. That’s why we introduce the Gadget system: consumable power-ups you can buy, carry with you and unbalance the battle. Life pools. Poison areas. Gadgets bring an unprecedented layer of customization, and mean life or death on harder missions.

Of course if we give you all this equipment, we need a place to go shopping, right? Enter the new shop! And also, pay attention to the contract end screens, these have all been revamped and now do a much better job at getting you excited about the new equipment you just earned.

This one is self-explanatory. Yes, a campaign map. A lovely one indeed, +20 contracts for you to unlock and master. Go check it out! And, while we are at it, new tutorials so all game systems are explained.

You have been crossing a perilous land for 45 minutes. Only to reach the final boss who, as bosses do, kills you in one strike. Back to the start! So unfair. We have fixed that. The game now automatically saves progress at key moments, so you can restart from there. More fun. Less frustration.

We have replaced all the lighting code. Expect dark nights. Red sunsets. Rainy days. The kind of atmosphere that would feel extremely romantic, if it wasn’t because a ten ton monster is crushing your guts. So yeah, do kill the monster. But enjoy the views along the way.

Please be aware that CORE is temporarily only available in English and Spanish. A language pack including Italian, French, German, Russian, Simplified Chinese, Korean & Japanese support will be released next week as we confirm there are no bugs on the game.

Killsquad is an action-packed 4 player action RPG where sci-fi mercenaries raid planets seeking fame and glory. With three planets to explore, over twenty unique contracts to master, more than 100 weapons and 30 unique enemies, Killsquad offers an adrenaline-pumping journey into a dystopian future full of blood and black humour. Killsquad is now on Steam Early Access, with an approximate launch date of Summer 2021.

Killsquad is developed by Novarama, a Barcelona-based independent games developer with +18 years of experience, 11 of them as a Sony exclusive studio. With a team of +40 people, Novarama's mission statement is to building innovative games for mass audiences. Killsquad is our first fully self-published game. Visit Novarama's website at www.novarama.com
